opening.argument: The video is grounded in AVAX chart analysis, using Elliott Wave framing to assess whether a local low has formed. It presents higher prices as only a possibility and expressly requires further confirmation before treating an upward trend as established. That conditional treatment, together with the channel’s stated informational and educational purpose, supports ordinary market commentary. The disclosed affiliate links separately promote trading services, but the available evidence establishes no deception, inaccurate claims, transactions, or losses.
